shortDescription: Endeavour Silver NYSE:EXK plunges 12.1% in Wednesday's trading a day after cutting processing capacity at its Guanacevi mine in Mexico by nearly half after the company said a mechanical issue will require the replacement of the mill head and trunnion, forcing the operation's primary ball mill offli…

at its Guanacevi mine in Mexico by nearly half after the company said a mechanical issue will require the replacement of the mill head and trunnion, forcing the operation's primary ball mill offline.
said it expects to take about three weeks to complete repairs at Guanacevi, which is its highest-grade silver mine and produced 3.92M oz of silver in 2025.
During the repair period, the regrind circuit will be configured to operate at a reduced throughput of 600 metric tons/day, compared to ordinary course capacity of ~1,100 tons/day.
CIBC analyst Cosmos Chiu downgraded Endeavour

to Neutral from Outperform with a C$20 price target, cut from C$25, noting the incident is the second trunnion replacement needed at Guanacevi in less than two years; however, with parts available on site this time, management expects a significantly shorter repair timeline than the 15 weeks of downtime in H2 2024.

However, the incident also marks the second interruption to the company's operations in the current quarter, after the blockade at Terronera disrupted operations and impacted production over a 12-day period
, and taken collectively, the two events "could affect the company's ability to meet full-year guidance," Chiu said.

The analyst said his updated model for Guanacevi now forecasts full-year production of 8.28M oz of silver and 44.7K oz of gold, compared with prior guidance of 8.3M-8.9M oz of silver and 46K-48K oz of gold, while cost guidance for the year is also at risk of revision, with H1 2026 all-in sustaining costs raised to $36.96/oz, compared with full-year guidance of $27-$28/oz at the corporate level.
